abi: short sync  proposing CI-driven snapshots + a shadow-apply path. want quick feedback.
ryan: what does shadow-apply do?
abi: fork a sampled subset of requests to the snapshot path, populate caches, run routing logic, collect metrics but dont change live routing.
tara: nice. need clear mismatch contract — what counts as mismatch? variant selection OR output diff?
ryan: suggest mismatch = variant-id change OR output signature change (hash). record both.
phil: approvals: >10% cohort = 2 approvers, >50% = 3 approvers. signed-by CI key required for prod apply.
abi: API sketch:
POST /v1/configs/snapshots 
body { source: "ci", source_ref: "ci/4821", note: "pre-canary" } -> 201 { snapshot_id }
POST /v1/configs/snapshots/:id/apply 
body { mode: "shadow-apply|staging-sync|canary|promote", cohort: "5%", cache_flush: "soft|hard", expected_base_version: "v123", force: false }
returns shadow_metrics when mode=shadow-apply.
ryan: divergence handling: return 409 + divergence_summary. CLI can `--rebase` to auto-merge non-conflicting keys.
tara: add orphan-key detector: if snapshot removes keys referenced elsewhere, block when block_on_orphans=true and show list.
phil: telemetry events: snapshot.created, snapshot.shadowed, snapshot.staged, snapshot.canaried, snapshot.promoted, snapshot.rolled_back. include snapshot_id, signer, cohort, shadow_mismatch_rate, predicted_blast_radius_pct.
abi: secrets: redact in snapshot payload, include secret_refs pointing to KMS. snapshots encrypted at rest and signed.
ryan: retention: CI snaps default 14d, manual 30d, org opt-in to 1y. soft-delete 48h. GC worker daily.
phil: UI: snapshot list row with badges (signed_by, shadow-status, blast-radius). diff viewer shows per-key owner and orphan warnings.
abi: tests: add CI-e2e: create CI snapshot, shadow-apply, assert shadow_mismatch_rate < 0.5%, staging-sync, canary 1%, verify metrics.
ryan: edge: cache_flush soft should expire prefixes gracefully; hard requires approver.
infra-bot: snapshot sn-ci-4821-0001 created by CI pipeline ci/4821 signed_by=ci-key-01 :white_check_mark:
abi: action items:
- abi: write RFC + minimal API (ETA Mon)
- ryan: proto runtime shadow sampling (ETA Thu)
- tara: orphan-key linting (ETA Wed)
- phil: console mockups (ETA Wed)
thanks all.
